Recording all 1120 would need that rule written and committed BEFORE recording starts (the same reasoning that forbids selecting on observed behaviour elsewhere in the plan applies to picking a subset after seeing the population size). Not resolved by this script; flagged for the co-authors rather than decided unilaterally.
